name: Rolen Standard Straight Denim
description: Mid-rise straight-leg jeans in classic indigo denim, worn soft through the thighs and knees. Five-pocket construction with flat-riveted stress points. No frills, no tech — just a well-cut pair of jeans that holds up to daily wear in M88's lower tiers.
what_it_says: You buy practical and you don't overthink it. You've had this pair for two years and it still fits.
story_hooks: A faded stamp inside the waistband reads a batch number tied to a recalled lot — something the corponation never publicly acknowledged.
The buyer finds a previous owner's locker code written in marker on the inner hem.
